name: support-ticket-system
description: Support ticket system using Vector-SDK compiled to WASM

scripts.build: cd Vector-SDK && wasm-pack build --target web --features wasm && cd .. && cp -r Vector-SDK/pkg ./pkg
scripts.build:release: cd Vector-SDK && wasm-pack build --target web --release --features wasm && cd .. && cp -r Vector-SDK/pkg ./pkg
scripts.package: mkdir -p dist && cp -r pkg index.html server.js package.json dist/ && echo 'Package created in dist/ directory'
